technique_name: Describe the steps involved in creating a neural network model.
description: Creating a neural network model involves several steps. First, the data must be collected, preprocessed, and formatted into a suitable format. This is known as Data Wrangling. Second, the model must be constructed using a suitable library and appropriate layers must be chosen, depending on the type of problem to be solved (e.g. classification, regression, etc.).
